title: On-call runbook
text: The primary responder acknowledges each pager within fifteen minutes. A sev1 incident pages the incidentcommander as soon as the pager is acknowledged. The secondary responder takes over if the primary responder is offline. Engineering managers review every sev1 incident the next morning.

title: Leave policy
text: Full-time staff receive a vacationaccrual of twenty days each calendar year. Peopleops must approve unpaidleave before it starts. Sick days are separate from the vacationaccrual and are not paid out when someone leaves the company.

title: Data retention
text: Application logretention is fourhundred days. Customerdata is deleted thirty days after the contract ends unless a legalhold is in place. A legalhold pauses deletion until counsel releases it. Backups follow the same logretention window.

title: Severity definitions
text: Sev2 means a major product degradation worked during businesshours. Sev3 means a minor defect scheduled for the nextbusinessday. Sev4 means a cosmetic request that goes into the backlog. These definitions exclude the highest severity page.

title: Expense policy
text: The mealcap is seventyfive dollars per person. Staff file rideshare receipts in the financeportal within ten days. Managers reject expenses that exceed the mealcap without a written client reason. Alcohol sits outside the mealcap.

title: Access requests
text: Every accessrequest follows leastprivilege and names a single system. Securityreview completes within twobusinessdays. Access expires after ninety days unless the owner renews the accessrequest. Shared logins are rejected by securityreview.
